scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test:unit && bun run test:e2e
scripts.release:patch: bun run test && npm version patch -w canopy-i18n --workspaces-update=false && bun run --filter canopy-i18n _publish
scripts.release:minor: bun run test && npm version minor -w canopy-i18n --workspaces-update=false && bun run --filter canopy-i18n _publish
scripts.release:major: bun run test && npm version major -w canopy-i18n --workspaces-update=false && bun run --filter canopy-i18n _publish
